description: This file defines a persistent grain class 'SimplePersistentGrain' in Orleans, along with its associated state class 'SimplePersistentGrain_State'. The grain allows setting and retrieving two integer values, performing calculations, managing its activation lifecycle, and handling request context data.

classes.name: SimplePersistentGrain_State
classes.description: Serializable state class for 'SimplePersistentGrain', holding two integer properties A and B.

classes.name: SimplePersistentGrain
classes.description: A persistent Orleans grain implementing 'ISimplePersistentGrain', managing two integers, providing calculation methods, state management, and request context handling.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides base method; initializes grain on activation, creating a new version GUID and logging activation.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets property A in the grain state.

methods.name: SetA (overload)
methods.description: Sets property A and optionally deactivates the grain.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets property B in the grain state.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of A within the state.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B, either from the state or from provided parameters.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of A from state.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version GUID of the grain.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Retrieves the 'GrainInfo' object from request context.

methods.name: SetRequestContext
methods.description: Sets the 'GrainInfo' object in the request context.
